name: 复古绿磷 CRT
selection: GNU Unifont 18.0.01 alone for both Latin and Chinese; unchanged upstream font, process-local registration. Terminus TTF was compared and not selected.

cool_retro_term.role: Green palette reference only; its font is not distributed as part of this preset.
cool_retro_term.not_adopted: Terminus TTF 4.46.0 from this profile was compared against Unifont; it lacks the tested GB2312 Hanzi and relies on system Chinese fallback. It is not in the application font catalog or resources.

copyright_names: Copyright © 1998-2026 Roman Czyborra, Paul Hardy, Qianqian Fang, Andrew Miller, Johnnie Weaver, David Corbett, Ælla Chiana Moskopp, Rebecca Bettencourt, Ho-Seok Ee, et al.

available_licenses: GPL-2.0-or-later with GNU font embedding exception
unifont_license.notice: Unifont has offered both licenses since 13.0.04; retain original font copyright metadata and the bundled OFL text.

coverage.verified: ASCII 95/95, GB2312 Hanzi 6763/6763, chosen CJK punctuation 34/34, simplified and traditional sample characters 14/14 each. Independent cmap counts match CoreText font character sets.
coverage.boundary: Some supplementary-plane glyphs exist: U+30EDE 𰻞 is present, U+20BB7 𠮷 and U+20000 𠀀 are absent. No blanket claim that all non-BMP glyphs are absent or all GB18030 characters supported.
coverage.fallback: Missing glyphs use system fallback when available. On the test Mac U+20000 reaches LastResort; 😀 and 📝 use AppleColorEmoji. These are not counted as Unifont coverage.

distribution: Only the catalog, license and provenance are bundled with the host. The single Unifont binary downloads only on explicit user selection into app-private cache.
